races.paceDynamic: Soir De Garde will take this field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters to challenge his early lead. The Mullins runner can dictate terms through steady sectionals over this stamina test, while prominent runners Ndaawi and Therellbeguddaysyet sit within striking distance. The majority of this field are hold-up horses (Absurde, Sageborough, Busselton, No Looking Back) who will need the pace to develop properly to get their ground. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the modest gallop and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Soir De Garde Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Soir De Garde gets an uncontested lead and maintains control of the gallop
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can string out the field with his relentless galloping style, making it difficult for the hold-up horses to pick up the pieces. His recent wins show he's best when allowed to dominate from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ndaawi or Therellbeguddaysyet can track Soir De Garde and outkick him late
scenarios.body: The class horse Ndaawi has the tactical speed to sit prominent and use his superior rating, while the returning Therellbeguddaysyet could benefit from the strong gallop. Both can position themselves perfectly behind the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing and allows the back markers to close strongly
scenarios.body: Absurde's class could shine through if given the right race shape, though his recent form is questionable. The stamina demands could suit his style if others have gone too hard early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Soir De Garde goes too slow early and gets swamped by a wall of closers
scenarios.body: A tactical affair could allow multiple hold-up horses to arrive together, creating chaos in the finish. This would particularly suit horses with a turn of foot over this staying trip.

races.paceDynamic: Kimi De Mai will take this race forward from the outset, with Poetic Twist, Crystal Gold and Somersby Roost tracking prominently in the early stages. The pace should be genuine but sustainable given the limited early speed in this maiden field. Dictionary Corner, Tountinna and Ardeen Joy are all confirmed hold-up horses who will need the race to develop, but several of them show concerning finishing tendencies. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can position close to Kimi De Mai and strike when the pace lifts, as the hold-up brigade face too many question marks over their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kimi De Mai sets steady fractions and gets headed approaching the last
scenarios.body: The early pace-setters will come back to the field, allowing the best prominent tracker to time their challenge perfectly. Crystal Gold or Poetic Twist can exploit their superior class ratings in this tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kimi De Mai gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Mullins' mare to build an unassailable advantage, with her proven stamina reserves carrying her home. The hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the front-runners tire
scenarios.body: Dictionary Corner or Tountinna could benefit from a strong gallop that sets up their preferred finishing kick. However, both have shown concerning finishing tendencies that make this scenario less reliable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Kimi De Mai goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A crawling pace could allow an outsider with tactical speed to steal this, though the prominent runners still hold most of the cards. Courtmac Gesture might find this tactical pattern more suitable.

races.paceDynamic: Sainte Lucie and Cappa Hill will dispute the early lead, with Sainte Lucie's Mullins connections likely pushing the tempo from the outset. The prominent brigade of Monbeg Park, Its Bilbo, Coyote Spirit, Balko d'Ange, Pray Tell, Autumn Twist, Sequoiaspirit, Elusive Ogie, D Art D Art, and Larzac creates a wall of 10 runners wanting that second-third position - this will cause significant interference and scrimmaging from 2-3 out. With only 6 hold-up runners (County Final, I'm Slippy, Rockymountainbleu, Ifallgoeswell, Open Secret, Tassarolo, Butter Fingers) in a 20-runner field, the pace will be strong throughout. This congested prominent battle and honest gallop heavily favours the hold-up merchants who can avoid the traffic and finish strongest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent wall creates expected traffic chaos 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The 10 prominent runners will interfere with each other while hold-up runners get clear runs down the outside. County Final and I'm Slippy have the class to capitalise on the carnage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early leaders collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Sainte Lucie and Cappa Hill go too fast early
scenarios.body: The pace duel will set up the race for closers, with prominent runners also feeling the effects of a strong gallop. Tassarolo's recent Hogan form and Open Secret's Elliott polish make them dangerous.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent survivors prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack manages to avoid serious interference
scenarios.body: One or two from the prominent wall find clear water and kick away from rivals who get hampered. Its Bilbo's De Bromhead polish and Coyote Spirit's class could see them through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runners steal march
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders get an uncontested lead and kick clear
scenarios.body: Sainte Lucie or Cappa Hill exploit the prominent congestion behind them to build an unassailable advantage. Only viable if the prominent pack neutralises itself completely.

races.paceDynamic: Onlymammycanloveme is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset in this 16-runner handicap hurdle over three miles. With prominent runners like West Cork Wildway, Toor Khov, and Sarandon likely to track but not pressure early, the pace will be genuine but sustainable. The large field of hold-up horses including Getaway Charlie, Jeriko De Baune, Themanintheanorak, and West Is Awake will create a bunched finish as they try to pick off the leaders. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick clear before the hold-up brigade arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady without pressure on Onlymammycanloveme
scenarios.body: West Cork Wildway, Toor Khov, and Ishan can track the leader and have first run on the field turning for home. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up in a large field over this stamina test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainable with multiple prominent runners pressing forward
scenarios.body: The early leaders will tie up in the closing stages, allowing strong finishers like Jeriko De Baune and Themanintheanorak to sweep past. Their fresher legs and tactical positioning will prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Onlymammycanloveme faces minimal early pressure and gets loose on the front end
scenarios.body: The topweight can dictate his own fractions and prove too tough to peg back despite carrying 167lbs. His recent course and distance victory shows he handles these conditions perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with tactical riding throughout
scenarios.body: Lightly-weighted runners like West Clare and Committee Meeting can benefit from the chaos of a slowly-run race. Their lower ratings become less relevant when the race turns into a sprint finish.

The lack of genuine front-runners means the gallop will be controlled through the early stages, with the real racing beginning from the final mile. Nowwhatdoyouthink will drop in last from his hold-up position, relying on the pace quickening late to bring his stamina into play. This controlled tempo strongly favours horses with tactical speed and finishing kicks over pure front-runners.

scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady with Classic Getaway unchallenged
scenarios.body: The gallop builds gradually, allowing hold-up horses to close strongly as the leaders tire from the third-last fence. Nowwhatdoyouthink's stamina and tactical positioning prove decisive in this stamina test.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents Nowwhatdoyouthink from getting competitive, with the race won by a horse that travelled kindly in the leading group. The winner emerges from those who stayed prominent throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Classic Getaway Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse challenges Classic Getaway's lead until too late
scenarios.body: The Willie Mullins-trained veteran uses his experience to control the fractions and kick clear approaching the final fence. His class advantage over this field proves decisive when allowed to dictate terms.

scenarios.trigger: If the mare travels exceptionally well and quickens best from the second-last
scenarios.body: Her recent form improvement continues as she outstays the others in the final furlong, with connections' confidence in stepping her up in class vindicated. The combination of good recent form and race fitness proves crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Wingmen appears the most natural front runner in this small field, with his prominent style and Elliott's positive recent form giving him control from the start. Mister Pink and Funiculi Funicula are likely to track closely given their prominent preferences, but neither looks aggressive enough to pressure Wingmen early. The lack of genuine pace pressure should create a steady rhythm that builds gradually, with the real contest developing from the last mile as the prominent runners try to kick clear of hold-up runner Ocastle Des Mottes. This moderate tempo strongly favours the prominent runners who can travel well within themselves before producing their finishing effort.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wingmen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Wingmen dictates an uncontested lead and maintains his jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: Elliott's charge gets first run on his rivals and proves too strong when pressed, with the controlled pace suiting his front-running style perfectly. Funiculi Funicula and Mister Pink chase him home but can't reel him in despite their class advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mullins One-Two Punch
scenarios.trigger: If Funiculi Funicula travels smoothly and Ocastle Des Mottes gets the perfect pace setup
scenarios.body: The Mullins pair capitalize on their superior class, with Funiculi Funicula's higher rating telling while Ocastle Des Mottes benefits from the steady gallop to close strongly. Wingmen's honest effort earns him a place but lacks the class to win.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mister Pink Returns Winner
scenarios.trigger: If O'Sullivan's runner shows no signs of his long absence and jumps fluently throughout
scenarios.body: The 441-day break proves irrelevant as Mister Pink's proven class at this level shines through, benefiting from the solid pace to time his challenge perfectly. His superior course form gives him the edge over the Mullins runners in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a war of attrition with jumping errors or falls affecting the principals
scenarios.body: Either Scalpnagoon rediscovers his winning form or Major Wells proves his recent struggles were temporary, capitalizing on a chaotic finish. The moderate gallop allows one of the lesser lights to stay in touch and pounce late.
